name: Bowl with Variegated Russet Glaze with Small Brown Flecks
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably late 11th-early 12th century；Russet Ding ware: porcelaneous white stoneware with russet-surfaced dark brown glaze, the markings in overglaze iron-oxide. Probably from the kilns at Jianci villiage, possibly from those at East or West Yanchuan village, Quyang county, Hebei province.
